classification.difficultyReason: Use both named rules to check the same length while respecting rounded angle data.

content.prompt: Find the length of the missing side to 1 d.p. by using cosine rule, then check your answer using sine rule. The labelled angles may be rounded.

spec.description: Black triangle with horizontal base and apex above and left of centre. Left side labelled 2 cm outside; base labelled 2.5 cm below. Interior lower-left angle labelled 60 degrees and lower-right angle labelled 50 degrees, without arcs. Right sloping side unlabelled. No visible vertex letters or c label.
spec.mathematics: 49.1 degree correction applied to diagram and sine-rule check; cosine and sine results both 2.3 cm.
spec.editorialReview: The description records source appearance; active values and geometry follow the approved correction log.

answer.short: $2.3\text{ cm}$ by both rules to 1 d.p.
answer.worked:
Cosine rule:
$$\color{#268cff}\begin{align*}c^2&=2^2+2.5^2-2(2)(2.5)\cos60^\circ\\c&=\sqrt{5.25}\\c&\approx2.3\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
Sine rule:
$$\color{#268cff}\begin{align*}\frac{c}{\sin60^\circ}&=\frac{2}{\sin49.1^\circ}\\c&=\frac{2\sin60^\circ}{\sin49.1^\circ}\\c&\approx2.3\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
